verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Calendly publishes an API v2 reference with per-endpoint pages (webhook create, list and delete; a sample webhook data endpoint) and static code snippets. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer, a try-it console, or runnable examples. A static reference is a related but different feature, so it earns no credit toward the interactive, runnable story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
